resources.string: Mirror one finger by screen proportion

Maps the touch area to the target screen by width and height. Different aspect ratios stretch the path; match screen orientation for closer results. Sends single-finger taps, double taps, holds and drags. Adding another finger releases the remote touch and pauses input until all fingers lift. Pinch two fingers inward to exit. No remote screen image is shown.
Touch connection unavailable. Reconnect the target device.
Pinch two fingers inward to exit
Press Back again within 2 seconds to exit touch passthrough
Screen pinning is not active. Home protection has not taken effect.
Could not unpin. Use the system unpin gesture shown when pinning started.

Optional Home protection. Entry prompts come from the system. Two-finger exit releases pinning started by this app. To stay unlocked afterward, disable the system setting that locks the device when unpinning, if available.
Largest centered area at the selected screen ratio. A stroke can start outside: touch begins at the boundary when it enters. Taps outside do nothing.
